text_method: Gated bounded probability fusion on exact-taxonomy candidates only
semantic_method: Independent raw-SAM text feedback after shared frozen-teacher candidate gate; reject strong pixel conflicts
I2: class_aware uncertainty1024, rare IDs[3,4,6,7], reserve.15, num_maskmem9

text_fusion.scope: original DINO boxes and valid FoV coverage; coarse/free queries exactly fall back

no_circular_evidence: The semantic-derived text refinement is not re-fed as independent evidence; raw SAM masks enter feedback once after the common gate.
core_extension: Not adopted: ~0.01pp text change did not justify extra thresholds.

training.source: Cityscapes2975 full source set, deterministic sampled order
training.target: 160 images (4 each of40 cities), deterministic shuffled order matched within seed
